༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i cho ga khams gsum zil gnon gyi dmigs rim gyis man ngag gi yi ge snying dang 'dra

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i

cho ga khams gsum zil gnon gyi dmigs rim gyis man ngag gi yi ge snying dang 'dra ba/ gzhan la gsang ba'i man ngag bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i khro rgyal gshin rje gshed mthar byed chen po'i rigs kyi las tshogs dang 'brel bas bsgrub par bya ba/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i cho ga khams gsum zil gnon zhes bya ba la/ dang por stod las byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba zhes bya ba las/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i skabs rnams spyir nas go sla ba las/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ rje btsun nyid kyi man ngag nas 'byung bzhin/ dmigs pa brtan po dang bcas/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs rnams phyir bskrad pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal 'debs pa sogs/ rta khal ma dang*/ gshed dmar 'khrul 'joms las gzigs 'tshal sngags bsdu ba'i skabs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi zhes pa dang*/ 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i skabs/ khams gsum snod bcud zhes pa'i skabs/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rang la thim zhes pa'i skabs/ dmigs pa gnad che ba zab 'tshal/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod gtor 'bul bas skabs thams cad du bzlas nang la dmigs pa yin na'ang*/ zhabs su/ [ bla ma ] dang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed pos bdag la mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir khro bzlas tshab 'tshal/ bkra shis/ / de nas smad las dgra bgegs sgral ba/ snyan gsan dbabs pa/ ma nyes par dpang gzigs pa/ bsgral chog /btab gtong zor lam dbye ba/ zor 'phang ba/ zor lam gcod pa las/ snyan gsan dbabs pas/ gzi dpang gnyis go sla/ de nas bsgral chog gi skabs gzhan rnams go sla/ ling ga bskyed pa'i skabs bsad las dang sbyar bas/

bsad pa yin na go sla/ bzlog pa la bgegs lus rid cing nyam chung ba zhes pa'i skabs/ bgegs de dngos su gsal ba yod na rang gi ming gis 'bod cing de'i 'khor dang sprul ba yang sprul rnams la dmigs pa gtad/ liṅga sgrol ba'i skabs dgra bgegs lha dang 'phral ba'i skabs/ sngags kyi 'phral ba/ mchod pa'i 'phral ba/ rdzas kyi 'phral ba gsum la nan tan bskyed pa 'tshal/ gsal ba rnam pa gsum gsal 'debs/ rang yi dam du gsal ba las byed/ phur ba yi dam gyis thugs sprul du gsal ba/ liṅga dgra bgegs dmigs bsal gang min du bsal ba zhes pa dang*/ tshe lung khrus long med na shan pa yin zhes te/ rang sgrub pa po tshe dang bsod nams sogs kyis kyang tshangs na/ dam can srung ma sha khrag bdud rtsi rnam pa lngar gyur pas gsol ba'i tshangs pa/ dgra bgegs gnas kyi tshangs pa zhes pa/ kho yi rnam shes ā yig skya 'char re ba de/ gnas gsum sogs nas 'thon/ phur bu'i khong seng nas mar drang te phaṭa ces pa'i ngang nas rgyal ba mi bskyod zhing ngam/ bde ba can la sogs par gnas spar de/ phaṭa ces bskrad pas stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po'i ngang du bzhag /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang tshogs drug gsung chos skad spyi'i dpang du bzhag /yang gsang sngags spyi la gnad sbyor gnyis gnad che ba yin zhes gsungs pa yang go dgos so/ /'di yi 'phro las 'di ltar 'brel ba 'bum nag las/ liṅga dang ni nya mo gnyis/ /dmigs pa cag te rgya ru mi cag /liṅga nya mo 'di nyid snying gar zhugs/ /dus ni smin drug sa 'og dus/ /'bri mkhan rme mkhan dam tshig bla ma dang*/ slob dpon la nyams zhes bshad pa'i lung yang yod do/ /btab gtor skabs ltar byas pa bsad bzlog gang yin kyang zab pa'i gnad do/ /zor lam dbye ba/ yang rgyud 'bral ba'i ngang gser skyems la sogs dang*/ dmigs pa gsal ngang nas bya/ de nas zor 'phangs pa'i skabs gtor ma'i lha nam mkhar 'deg pa'am bris sku la bstims pa yang bshad do/

/de nas sprul gzhi sgrub khang der bzhugs shing*/ sprul pa yang sprul rnams sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khang pa che ba ri rab/ chung ba yung 'bru yang chung rdul phran du gyur na gang la dmigs pa'i yul khams sogs khang nas/ las gang la gang 'tshams pa med cing*/ gtor ma de yang dug dang zhes pas dug dug za dang sna tshogs dang me dang*/ mtshon cha'i phung po dang gnam lcags kyis thog sogs su gyur nas/ dgra bgegs lhag ma til 'bru tsam yang med par bsam ste/ de'i ngang nas stong pa nyid kyi don bsam mod/ de'i zor lam bcad par bya ste/ de mtshams 'byung ba lnga yi dkyil 'khor bsam pa dang*/ ri bdun rol ba'i mtsho bdun bsam pa/ de la phur bus rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ dang po gcig pus bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ thabs las dug kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /ma k+ṣi'i sbyor ba'i lcags kyang gser/ /'chi ster dbyug gu'i ye shes cher/ /'dod pa kun 'byung ngo mtshar rmad/ /zhes dang*/ dpal ldan rgyud chen gsang ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /dngos grub kun 'byung yid bzhin nor rnyed pa/ /bdud las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pas/ /phun tshogs 'gro la phan bde dar gyur cig / dang*/ rwa lo gsum pa tā ra nā thā yis/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i man ngag 'di/ /zhal gyis gdams pa yi ger bkod nas kyang*/ /man ngag yi ge snying dang 'dra ba yi/ /grub mtha' kha khar spel na bka' rgya yod/ /slob ma dam tshig ma nyams snying 'dra bas/ /de rnams ma rtogs kun la gsang ba gyis/ /gzhan la spel na phyi mar nā ra gan/ /dge legs 'phel bar shog / shu bhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 146 -- PAGE 147 -- PAGE 145 -
